input.answer:
Ontario's rent component of the CPI (not seasonally adjusted, Rent, Ontario) rose by 2.0% between September 2025 and September 2026.

Calculation: the index went from 161.2 (2025-09) to 164.4 (2026-09). Change = (164.4 − 161.2) / 161.2 × 100 = 3.2 / 161.2 × 100 ≈ 1.985%, which rounds to 2.0%.

Source: Statistics Canada table 18-10-0004 (Consumer Price Index, monthly, not seasonally adjusted), vector 41691954.
